subject: english
stem: The school office has sent the following message. Which action is planned or required in the full message?
options: show the Bike Safety Fair ticket at the first door
take photos in the Bike Safety Fair workshop
keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door
leave the Bike Safety Fair ticket in the first room

optionRationales.reason: show the Bike Safety Fair ticket at the first door：此項把「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last」改成「show the Bike Safety Fair ticket at the first」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。因此，鎖定證據支持「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。

take photos in the Bike Safety Fair workshop：此項把「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」改成「take photos in the Bike Safety Fair workshop」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。因此，鎖定證據支持「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。
keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。

leave the Bike Safety Fair ticket in the first room：此項把「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」改成「leave the Bike Safety Fair ticket in the first room」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。因此，鎖定證據支持「keep the Bike Safety Fair ticket for the last door」。
